content: Jana John yarkinkaku kunin.
Yala-yalabi Herod, nyulu maja jirray bubuku Galileemunku. Nyulu kuku nyajin Jesusanka.
Nyulu balu Jesus nyajin John the Baptist. Nyulu nyunguwunbu workingmenanda yalaman, “John The Baptist juranman baja yarkinmun; nyulukuda Jesus. Yinyaynka nyulu junkurrji, miracle balkanka.”

Philip, nyulu yabaju Herodamu. Herodangka ngadiku Philipamu manyarr ngakin, kujin, manyarr-bungan. Manyarr burri Herodias. Johnungku Herodanda yalaman, “Yundu yabajumu manyarr kari wunanyaku. Nyungun bawa.” Herod bula Herodias kuli-kadaynda, soldier-soldier yungan John karrbanka, jailba mumbanka.
Herodangka John yarkinkaku kuninka, yamba nyulu yinyilman bamanka Jew-warranka. Jana bama Jew-warra jana-karrajiku balkawan, “Nyulu Johnungku Godumu kuku manubajakuda balkal-balkal.”
Herodamu birthdayman, nyulu party haveim-bungan. Bama wubul partynga kadan. Herodiasamu kangkal maral wurin jakalba jananda. Herod wawurr-wawurrman nyungunku.
Herodangka maralanda yalaman, “Ngayu wanyu yunu dajil? Yundu wanyurrinku wawu? Ngayu yunu dajilkuda. Jana yindu-yinduynju nganya nyajin yunun wawurr-wawurr-bunganya. Ngayu dajilkuda.”

Maralangka nyunguwunbu ngamundu babajin, “Ngayu wanyurrinku babaji?” Ngamungku yalaman, “Yundu babajika Johnundumunku dukulku.” Yinyamun maralangka Herodanda babajin, “Yundu Johnumu dukul ngaykundu daya platemunbu.”
Nyulu King Herod milka-bujarmanda. Yamba nyulu murruji kuku jurrkinka, jawun-karrangka nyungun nyajinya maral wawurr-wawurr-bunganya anything dajinka. Yinyaynka nyulu dajinka.
Nyulu kuku yungan jailmunbu, jana Johnumu dukul nyandanka.
Jana dukul plateba yijarrin, maralanda dajin. Nyulu maralangka ngamundu dajin.
Johnundumundu jawun-karrangka nyungun yarkin manin, nandan. Yinyamun jana dungarin, Jesusanda balkan.
Jesusangka mayi bamanga wubulbu bajaku dajin.
Jesusangka yinya kuku Johnunku nyajin, nyulu yinyamun bubumun boatji dungan, bubungu jirrbu-jirrbungu. Jana bamangka nyajin nyungun dunganya, jana town-townmun dungarin, nyungun jinabu wukurrin.
Nyulu Jesus boatmun jalaman bubungu, nyulu bama wubul nyajin yinyaymba. Nyulu jiba-badin jananka, jananin ngulkurr-bungan bambaymun.
Yilaylayman, nyungu jawun-karra 12-bala nyungundu kadarin, yalaman, “Yanyu bubu jirrbu-jirrbu, mayi yamba-kari, yilaylaymanda. Jananin bama yungada, townbu dunganka, mayi maninka janangaku.”
Yamba Jesusangka yalaman, “Jana wawubu kari dungay. Yurraku jananda mayi daya.”
Jana yalaman, “Nganjinanga mayi bread 5-balaku, minya kuyu jambulku.”
Jesusangka yalaman, “Ngaykundu wundi.”

Nyulu bamanda wubulbuku balkan jikanba bundarinka. Yinyamun nyulu bread 5-bala, minya kuyu jambul manin, jiri nyajin, God thankim-bungan mayika, minyaka. Jesusangka mayi and minya dumbarrin, jawun-karranda dajin. Jawun-karrangka bamanga wubulbuku wamban.
Bamangka wubulduku nukan, yanjimankuda. Jana basket 12-bala jakal-bungan mayibu yandaynja.
Dingkar-dingkarangka 5000-balangka mayi nukan. Janawundu jalbu-jalbungku, kangkal-kangkalangka yalarrku nukan.
Jesus wuyara banaburr jinabu dungan.
Jesusangka jawun-karra 12-bala jakalba yungan, naka-naka jalunbu boatji. Nyulu bama wubulku bayanbaku yunganda.
Yinyamun nyulu wuburrbu nyulurrku dakan, balkawanka Godunji. Wujurrmanda, nyulu nyulurrku yinyaymba bundan.
Jana jawun-karra boatji dungan-dungarin jalunbu dindarra, kala-kalbay bubumun. Jarramali yaykarrku kadan. Jana birungubaynja murruji manin, muyarabu boat yimbal-yimban.
Mudu-wayjunjiku, Jesus jananda kadan. Nyulu jalunbu wuyar-wuyar jinabuku kankadan.
Jana jawun-karrangka nyungun banaburr nyajin wuyar-wuyar kankadanya, jana yinyilmarinya, yararrin. Jana yalaman, “Nyulu yinya Dububi!” Jana yirrkan, yinyilmarinya.
Nyulu jananda yalamanda, “Bangkarr dandimaka, ngayu Jesus. Kari yinyilmaka.”
Peterangka nyungundu yalaman, “Maja, kaki yundukuda, nganya kunja, ngayu yunundu kadanka.”
Jesusangka yalaman, “Kadayda.” Peter jalaman, banaburr wuyar-wuyar dungan Jesusanda.
Yamba nyulu nyajinda, muyar, mulngku. Nyulu yinyilmanda, bada dungan-dungaynda. Balu bujil-janjilkuda. Nyulu yirrkan, “Maja, karrbada!”
Jesusangka jinbaldaku Peter karrban, nyungundu yalaman, “Yundu nganya kari warmbinyaku. Nganya believeim-bunganyaku.”
Bula boatbu dakan, muyar kunbaynda, jalun marrkamanda.
Jana boatbuku nyungun buyay-manin, yalaman, “Yundu Godumukuda kangkalkuda.”
Jesusangka bambay-bambay ngulkurr-bungan bubungu Gennesaret.
Jana naka-naka dungarin, bubungu Gennesaretba kadarin.
Jana bamangka yinyaymba Jesus nyungun-bungan, kuku yungan bamanda wubulbuku yiringkurrku yinyaymba bubungu. Jana bambay-bambay wubulku nyungundu wundin.
Jana Jesusanda babajin, bambay-bambaynja nyungu kambi karrbanka. Jana bambay-bambaynja Jesusamu kambi karrban, ngulkurrmaynda.
